It's basically… Rocket League
FlagshipBeginner-first2-min roundsContent-ready

"Teams push a giant glowing ball into goals. Pure chaos, pure clip."

How it plays
  • 2v2 or 3v3 · boarded arena · big light foam ball
  • 2–3 minute matches, most goals win
  • No driving skill — just chase the ball
Why it works
For beginners

Zero skill wall: everyone can chase a ball. Teams mean nobody's alone.

For content

The poster shot. Team energy + crowd noise + a ball in the net = the reel that sells the event.
